# CumulativeFlowChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A Kanban board, and the cumulative flow diagram over its history

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasEngineCharts](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChartElement> CreateCumulativeFlowChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChartElement> CreateCumulativeFlowChartFromKanban( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, const std::shared_ptr<KanbanDataSource>& board, const GanttDate& from, const GanttDate& to, int stepDays = 1, const std::string& title = "");   // Bound to a Kanban board's history with the three classic annotations.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCumulativeFlowChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onHoveredPeriodChanged` | `std::function<void(int periodIndex)> onHoveredPeriodChanged` | Hover moved to another period (-1 = left the plot). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `CFDStage`

One workflow stage band. `values[i]` is the item count in this stage at period i. Stage order follows the workflow: stages[0] is the first stage (To Do — drawn as the TOP band), stages.back() is the final stage (Done — drawn as the BOTTOM band), per CFD convention.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `values` | `std::vector<double> values` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Transparent = palette color |

### struct `CFDAnnotation`

A measurement annotation drawn onto the bands. Band *boundaries* are indexed by stage: boundary k is the top edge of stage k (the cumulative count of stages k..last). Boundary 0 is the overall top (arrival) curve; boundary stages-1 is the top of Done (departure curve).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `Kind kind = Kind::HorizontalSpan` |  |
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `fromBoundary` | `int fromBoundary = 0` | Left/upper boundary index |
| `toBoundary` | `int toBoundary = -1` | 1 = last boundary (top of Done) |
| `value` | `double value = -1` | Horizontal: item count; -1 = auto (half of |
| `position` | `double position = -1` | the final total) Vertical: period position (0-based, may be |

### enum `CFDLegendPosition`

Kept for API compatibility; mapped internally onto the shared ChartLegendPosition (Right -> RightCenter, Hidden -> legend hidden).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` |  |
| `Right` | Boxed side panel with a dot per stage |
